title: Priority Beacons: Cross-Org Initiative Intake and Release Funnel
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Goal: Create a repeatable intake-to-release funnel that ties every cross-functional initiative to a single company-level OKR 'beacon'. The funnel should make it unambiguous which objective an initiative advances, the levers to measure success, the minimum commitment window, and the gating criteria for rollout. This ticket delivers the playbook and the Linear/Confluence templates needed for the Q2 planning window.
context_and_rationale: We have observed recurring ambiguity during planning: teams launch features that tangentially align to OKRs but lack a clear hypothesis, measurement plan, and release gating. This causes duplicated work, unclear owner accountability, and missed measurement windows. Priority Beacons create a canonical mapping: one beacon = one company objective signal + 2 prioritized outcome metrics. The playbook lowers coordination friction while keeping flexibility for team-level execution.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published to Confluence with example intake form
Linear intake template created and linked; new intake label 'beacon-intake' auto-applied
Scoring rubric documented and accepted by PMs, Eng leads, and Design
Automation: Linear webhook posts a summary to #product-planning Slack channel on intake
Two pilot initiatives (one infra, one product) onboarded through funnel and tracked against beacons by end of pilot cycle
beacon_scoring_rubric: Impact alignment (0-5): How directly the initiative advances the company objective
Customer reach (0-3): % of active users/customers impacted
Cost/time friction (0-3): Estimated dev/infra months and operational runway
Dependency multiplier (x1 or x0.5): presence of blocking external dependencies reduces score
intake_form_fields: Primary metric and guardrails (metric name + baseline + target)
funnel_flow: 1) Beaconing: PM submits intake and assigns a beacon (OKR) and owner
2) Rapid triage (48h): Small cross-functional review (PM, Eng lead, Design, SRE) validates scoring
3) Scoping sprint: 2-week spike to finalize measurement plan and gating
4) Commitment window: initiative is scheduled into a release lane (canary/capacity sandbox)
5) Pre-release gating: safety/perf/metrics checks; sign-off required from SRE and Product
6) Post-release monitoring: 2 sprint observation window, rollback policy and regression alerting

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-bureaucratizing intake -> Mitigation: Keep intake form to essential fields, allow experimental 'fast lane' for <2 week spikes
Risk: Beacon mis-mapping (multiple initiatives claim same beacon) -> Mitigation: Prioritize by scoring and calendar windows; escalate conflicts to PM Triage
Risk: Missing observability -> Mitigation: Build measurement dashboard template and require baseline data as part of intake
Risk: Teams bypassing funnel when under time pressure -> Mitigation: Communication plan, slack automation reminders, and exec sponsorship

decisions: Adopt 'Priority Beacons' naming rather than 'Initiative Threads' (clearer to execs)
Score scale chosen: 0-5 impact & 0-3 for other dimensions to keep math simple
